title: Vendor Management Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: min 30-day termination notice (general); min 60-day for critical vendors; annual performance review

title: Data Privacy and Protection Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: data deletion within 30 days post-termination; breach notification within 24 hours; sub-processor approval required

title: Payment Terms Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: net 45-day payment terms; late fee cap 1.5%/month; advance payment >20% needs approval; price escalation cap 5%/year

title: Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: confidentiality survives 3 years post-termination; trade secrets indefinite; return/destroy within 30 days

title: Contract Termination and Notice Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: min 30-day notice for convenience; min 15-day cure period; min 15-day notice floor

title: Limitation of Liability Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: liability cap not below 12 months' fees; uncapped liability for data breaches; gross negligence carve-out required

title: Indemnification Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: IP infringement indemnity required; data breach indemnity required; not subject to general liability cap

title: Intellectual Property Assignment Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: work-for-hire IP assignment to company; perpetual royalty-free license for background IP

title: Non-Compete and Non-Solicitation Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: non-compete max 12 months; non-solicit max 24 months

title: Insurance Requirements Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: general liability min $1M; cyber liability min $2M; professional indemnity min $1M

title: Audit Rights Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: min 15 business days audit notice; min annual audit frequency

title: Dispute Resolution and Governing Law Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: 30-day good-faith negotiation before formal proceedings; injunctive relief carve-out required

title: Force Majeure Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: 10 business day notice of FM event; termination right after 60 consecutive days

title: Auto-Renewal and Contract Renewal Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: min 60-day non-renewal notice window; price increase cap 5%/renewal

title: Assignment and Change of Control Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: consent required for assignment; termination right on competitor change-of-control; 15 business day notice

title: Exclusivity and Most-Favored-Nation Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: exclusivity max 24 months without exec approval; MFN clauses require legal review

title: Warranty Policy
key_quantifiable_requirements: min 90-day warranty period; no-cost defect remedy; IP non-infringement warranty required
